edits.old: The pre-check answer shape for the cap and the hold is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0711; ASM-1258); this document fixes it as the refusal elements of the error table and leaves the field-level detail to the review with the app story.
edits.new: The pre-check answer for the cap and the hold is the refusal element of the error table: a reason code, the owner list with an open-case count and a cap for each owner, and the current and target state; the cap and the hold are read inside the operation before the first write.

edits.old: Then the selection element is marked Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0710; ASM-1257) where no source fixes an order or a required field
edits.new: Then the selection element is an ordered array in the caller's order, every result carries caseId and either the assignment or the messageId, and the summary is derived from the array and never from a second call

edits.old: Then the pre-check answer shape for the cap and the hold is marked Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0711; ASM-1258) and is fixed as the refusal elements of this document
edits.new: Then the refusal element carries a reason code, the owner list with an open-case count and a cap for each owner, and the current and target state, and the cap and the hold are read inside the operation before the first write so a refusal never leaves a partial change

edits.old: Then it carries the case ID, the decision code, the rule ID
edits.new: Then it carries the case ID, the decision code read at run time from LOV-DECISION as reference data, the rule ID

edits.old: Then it is published on rwb.decision-record.v1 and the central ledger in rwb-decision collects it
edits.new: Then it is published as rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1 and the central ledger in rwb-decision collects it

edits.old: Then the authorise check, the deviation read and the rule-model fetch are each one hop
edits.new: Then the authorise check, the deviation read of GET /api/recovery/deviation/v1/cases/{caseId}/deviations and the rule-model fetch are each one hop
